name: player_ai_finalize_mode2_state1_for_all_players
description: AINet::AiFinalizeMode2State1ForAllPlayers restores saved top-level AI state for AI-controlled players still in Mode2 State1 steering, then marks the global finalization flag.
known_limits: No isolated VC COFF byte comparison is recorded for this AI state-list helper; tier S verification is deferred to a coherent Player AI source-cluster pass.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly for 0x402f10 validates traversal from g_PlayerSaveStateListHead, lifecycleState == 2 and aiTopLevelState == 1 filtering, AINet::AiRestoreSavedTopLevelState(saveState) for matching entries, next traversal, and setting g_Player_AiMode2State1Finalized to 1 even when the list is empty.

The native smoke verifies a three-entry save-state list where only the AI Mode2 State1 entry is restored, nonmatching AI and inactive entries remain unchanged, and the finalized flag is set for both populated and empty lists.
